name: James McCloud
vampire_desc: An arrogant and pampered Scottish noble, born around 1050 AD. Soft from a life of luxury, surrounded by sycophants.
mortal_self: James McCloud, born 1050 AD in Scotland. A rich noble, pampered by slaves and surrounded by sycophants. Arrogant and soft.

memories.name: Memory 1
memories.description: Your mortal life â broad overview of who you were before the nights began.
experiences: I was born into silk and sycophants in the misty highlands around 1050 AD â surrounded by those who flattered every whim, I grew arrogant in the knowledge that the world would bend or break for me, not the other way round.

memories.name: Memory 2
memories.description: A memory in your immortal life â holds one Experience (two selected traits woven together).
experiences: The banner of a rival house burned over the borderlands, and in the reek of smoke and blood your swordsmanship became the final word your enemies heard; you felt nothing but the old warmth of the blade doing what it was forged to do.

memories.name: Memory 3
memories.description: A memory in your immortal life â holds one Experience (two selected traits woven together).
experiences: Elspeth begged you to spare the villages your raids had reduced to ghosts, and you let her have that mercy â not for her sake, but because her voice was one thread in the tapestry of cruelty you had learned to love that still held your hand.

memories.name: Memory 4
memories.description: A memory in your immortal life â holds one Experience (two selected traits woven together).
experiences: Jack's own retinue deserted him when your tactics stripped his lands bare, and you found his last letter burning in the hearth before you had to answer his challenge; the gem in your blade drank the light one last time.

memories.name: Memory 5
memories.description: A memory in your immortal life â holds one Experience (two selected traits woven together).
experiences: Sister Seraphina pressed the cold of the borderlands into your mouth and tasted the emptiness beneath your pride â there, where the leprosy ate her like slow fire, you found a hunger that would outlast the centuries, and you drank until the world sharpened and the wind in the highlands learned your name.

skills.name: Swordsmanship
skills.description: A master of the blade, deadly in the yard or on the battlefield.

skills.name: Falconry
skills.description: A noble pastime and a discipline of patience and control over the wild.

skills.name: Tactics and Command
skills.description: The art of warfare and strategy, learned in Bran's yard and your court.

resources.name: The Blackwood Seal Ring
resources.description: Your family's signet ring, cold iridium and heavy with history. It bears the crest of your house and has pressed into wax a thousand ledgers, proclamations, and death warrants. A sign of your standing.

resources.name: Blackwood Hall
resources.description: The fortress of your ancestors, perched on a jagged ridge where the wind never stops its wailing. Thick stone walls, a great hall that can house your entire retinue. The heart of your power.

resources.name: Wintersteel Broadsword
resources.description: A blade of grey steel, heavy and unyielding, brought from a campaign in the distant north. It never dulls, never chips, and its pommel is set with a dark gem that seems to draw the light from the air.

characters.name: Elspeth
characters.description: Younger sister. Smarter and kinder than James, she found refuge with the castle's animals â a wounded hawk, a stray hound, any creature in need of care. She loved James in spite of his arrogance; the only soul in that house who ever did.

characters.name: Jack Stewart
characters.description: Young lord from a nearby estate. Matched James line for line â in wealth, in station, in charm. Where James was born to privilege, Jack had earned his standing. Now courts the same girl James loves, turning rivalry into something that cuts deeper than pride.

characters.name: Bran
characters.description: Retired soldier and James's teacher. Grey-bearded, scarred, he drilled into James from the first dawn: kindness is the language of the weak. Paced the training yard before the sun until those words took root â ruthlessness, money, power. The only virtues.

characters.name: Sister Seraphina
characters.description: A leper saint of the borderlands, her face pocked and hands twisted by the disease that ate her from the outside in. She ran a hospice of corpses among the ruins of a border abbey. She chose James because she saw the hunger beneath his arrogance and fed it to him.

marks.description: A pair of small, pinprick scars on the forearm, where James drank Seraphina's corrupted blood. On cold nights, they burn; under moonlight, they glow faintly.
marks.concealment: Always hidden beneath gauntlets or heavy fur cuffs.
